categories.main_business_segments: Coxon Precise Industrial Co., Ltd. primarily operates in manufacturing precision plastic injection molded parts and molds, serving industries such as 3C electronics (mobile phones, digital cameras, game consoles, headphones), automotive parts, and optical instruments. The company also engages in surface treatment processes and international trade activities through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in mold development and manufacturing, plastic injection molding, and advanced surface treatment technologies including electroplating, sputtering, spraying, vacuum coating, laser engraving, and printing. It also integrates automated mold processing, dual-color and dual-material IMD forming, and incorporates PCR (post-consumer recycled) materials to enhance environmental sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major international 3C product manufacturers, including those in telecommunications, information technology, consumer electronics, automotive, and medical device sectors. The company serves global markets with a focus on high-precision plastic components for consumer electronics and automotive applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are centered in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Taoyuan and overseas subsidiaries in China (Dongguan, Changshu) and Samoa for investment and trade. Major sales markets include Taiwan, China, the United States, Japan, and other regions, with China being the largest revenue contributor.
categories.supply_chain_position: Coxon operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on mold design and manufacturing, plastic injection molding, and surface finishing services. It serves downstream manufacturers by supplying precision components and molds, while sourcing raw plastic materials upstream from suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes strengthening R&D in plastic surface treatment technologies and environmental sustainability by developing PCR materials and new sputtering processes. It aims to vertically integrate core technologies, expand product breadth, and develop niche products to differentiate from competitors. Continuous investment in mold development and process automation supports innovation and market responsiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of precision plastic components, molds, and related surface treatment services. The company also earns income from trading activities via its overseas subsidiaries. Sales are order-based, aligned with customer demand in the 3C and automotive sectors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Ying Ji, Wei Su, and Xin Zhi Sheng, which also produce plastic injection molded parts and surface treatments. Coxon differentiates itself by offering comprehensive vertical integration from mold design to surface finishing, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and a broad product portfolio, securing a strong position in the precision plastic components market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Coxon reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$3.14 billion, an 18.9% increase from the previous year, with a return to profitability after years of losses. The company has a stable asset base of over NT$3.4 billion and equity around NT$1.8 billion. Despite a recent scale reduction, growth is supported by improved product mix and operational efficiencies.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Coxon offers customers one-stop solutions combining mold development, precision injection molding, and diverse surface treatment technologies, backed by over 30 years of experience. Its ability to integrate multiple processes and develop environmentally friendly PCR materials provides competitive advantages in quality, innovation, and sustainability, meeting stringent customer requirements in high-tech industries.
